items.title: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%
items.titleZh: Google 的 AI 答案使搜索流量减少 40%

items.title: Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review
items.summary: Harvard study: AI coding agents raised code output 30 percent; finished work did not measurably rise, and getting code through review took 49 percent longer.
items.titleZh: 哈佛研究人员发现，AI 编程代理将瓶颈转移到了代码审查
items.summaryZh: 哈佛研究显示：AI 编程代理使代码产出提高了 30%，但已完成工作量并未显著增加；代码通过审查所需的时间延长了 49%。

items.title: Highly classified US national security communications network goes down
items.summary: The National Security Agency closed its campus to most employees on Tuesday night, reverting to essential personnel only as it works to bring its classified internal communications network back online, according to a voi…
items.titleZh: 高度机密的美国国家安全通信网络发生故障
items.summaryZh: 据一位发言人称，美国国家安全局周二晚间关闭园区，不允许大多数员工进入，仅保留必要人员，同时设法恢复其机密内部通信网络的运行。

items.title: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64
items.summary: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK
items.titleZh: Java4Shell：OpenJDK 处理 Base64 时存在远程代码执行漏洞
items.summaryZh: Java4Shell（CVE-2026-114938）：OpenJDK 中存在内存损坏漏洞。

items.title: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as revenues hit $104B
items.titleZh: 英伟达停止披露新加坡销售额，营收达到 1040 亿美元

items.title: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine
items.summary: Quad9's forced withdrawal from France highlights the dangers of mandating DNS-level blocking.
items.titleZh: Quad9 退出法国：煤矿里的金丝雀
items.summaryZh: Quad9 被迫退出法国，凸显强制实施 DNS 层级封锁的风险。

items.title: jQuery 4.1.0
items.summary: jQuery JavaScript Library. Contribute to jquery/jquery development by creating an account on GitHub.
items.summaryZh: jQuery JavaScript 库。你可以在 GitHub 上创建账户，为 jquery/jquery 项目贡献代码。

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
items.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
items.titleZh: 英伟达持有的初创公司股份价值飙升至 650 亿美元，但黄仁勋离任令未来交易蒙上阴影
items.summaryZh: 过去九个月，英伟达的私人投资价值接近增长两倍，这得益于黄仁勋积极促成交易，以及其现有投资组合公司的估值上升。

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
items.titleZh: 英伟达称营收将继续飙升——至少目前如此
items.summaryZh: 尽管创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋离任后英伟达陷入动荡，公司仍预计其创纪录营收势头不会就此止步。

items.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
items.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?
items.titleZh: 黄仁勋下台后，英伟达将放弃中国市场
items.summaryZh: 英伟达临时首席执行官称，公司将停止向中国销售芯片。这会带来多大损失？

items.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
items.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
items.titleZh: 英伟达称黄仁勋离任后其开源 AI 战略仍将保持不变
items.summaryZh: 尽管黄仁勋突然离任，英伟达临时首席执行官仍重申了公司的开源 AI 战略和收购 Hugging Face 的计划。

items.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.
items.titleZh: 英伟达称无意重新任命黄仁勋为首席执行官
items.summaryZh: 这位前首席执行官上周辞职后，曾提出重返公司最高职位。

items.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
items.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
items.titleZh: Anthropic 上市后，亚马逊和 Google 合计持股将接近 30%
items.summaryZh: Anthropic 上市后，亚马逊将持有略低于 15% 的股份，并有权大幅增持。Google 紧随其后，持股接近 14%。

items.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
items.summary: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.
items.titleZh: 据报道，黄仁勋离任之际，美国证券交易委员会正调查英伟达
items.summaryZh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，美国证券交易委员会正因首席执行官黄仁勋离任而对英伟达展开调查。黄仁勋曾承认与一名据称是中国间谍的人有染。

items.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
items.summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.
items.titleZh: Google 跟风科技故障潮，宣布自家服务没有故障
items.summaryZh: 科技服务似乎处处发生故障之际，Google 采取了不同寻常的做法，宣布 Gmail 运行一切正常。
